review.kind: M1 manual source classification, not runtime privacy certification
review.scope: First-party source under ruyi-workbench and mcp; generated/runtime/vendor/test directories excluded
review.instructions: Review changed source and call relations before manually updating fingerprints. No automatic classification refresh.

unknown.purpose: Conservative unresolved candidate; never evidence of protection
unknown.productionRelation: Source lexical candidate; full runtime dispatch is unresolved
unknown.evidence: Manual M1 review: static analysis limitation retained explicitly; see AUDIT.md

capability.purpose: Imported implementation may perform further sends
capability.productionRelation: Import capability, not a separate physical send
capability.evidence: Transport imports recorded independently from send sites; dependency internals are outside first-party source analysis

dynamic.transport: computed call / embedded code / shell / runtime import
dynamic.purpose: Dynamic dispatch can reach additional services, files or processes
dynamic.productionRelation: Computed call, browser evaluate, dynamic import or shell command; unresolved downstream graph
dynamic.evidence: M1 source review leaves these unknown; source fingerprints only request re-review

regex.productionRelation: Reviewed exec candidates are RegExp calls; no child_process.exec call exists in scanned current sources
regex.evidence: Review of all exec candidates; actual process exports spawn/execFile/spawnSync/execFileSync are separate records

local-callback.transport: local callback / async context / UI action
local-callback.purpose: Run local callback or in-memory transformation
local-callback.productionRelation: Same-named run/save/lookup/goto methods are local functions or AsyncLocalStorage/PrivacyGateway calls
local-callback.evidence: Source owners and first-party definitions reviewed; no direct transport in this candidate

ui-api.transport: same-origin fetch / UI API wrapper / event stream
ui-api.purpose: UI sends to workbench or loads same-origin locale/assets
ui-api.productionRelation: public net.apiRaw and direct /api calls; backend onward egress is separately classified
ui-api.evidence: First-party call-site review; no claim that a generic dynamic URL is restricted by the fetch primitive itself

audio-node.productionRelation: composer-voice AudioContext graph setup; no socket transport
audio-node.evidence: connect is an audio processing method, while audio POST paths use UI API and backend media records

ui-preview.purpose: Preview attachments or render local popup
ui-preview.productionRelation: createObjectURL or window.open blank page; download sites separately recorded
ui-preview.evidence: Object URL allocation is not network transmission

export.productionRelation: downloadRawEvents/exportSession/exportMemory/mermaid export; export may retain original local view
export.evidence: Source export builders have no common recipient-specific disclosure contract; downloads are external copies rather than network sends

credential-export.productionRelation: privacy-settings recovery export calls credential recovery API
credential-export.evidence: Encrypted credential backup is distinct from full work-data encryption or recipient disclosure; not labelled protected by this prototype

file-boundary.recipient: runtime file path (local, removable or network share unresolved)
file-boundary.purpose: Persist or export bytes at a caller-selected/internal path
file-boundary.productionRelation: writeFile/copyFile/createWriteStream/Python save/Office Save families; paths may be internal stores or user destinations
file-boundary.evidence: M1 cannot prove final filesystem target or downstream application disclosure; not counted as external network

process.purpose: Execute helper, shell, editor, browser or CLI
process.productionRelation: cp.spawn/execFile variants; Python subprocess/os.startfile; desktop Process.Start; delegates can independently access network
process.evidence: No OS network sandbox proven by this source-only prototype; local executable does not imply protected downstream egress

cli.purpose: Run agent task or CLI terminal command
cli.evidence: PrivacyGateway.assertSupported/assertCliAllowed refuse unsupported protected mode on existing entry paths, but off-mode CLI and future child/plugin sends remain unmanaged; no managed-mode delivery claimed

mcp.purpose: Call tools and receive MCP messages
mcp.productionRelation: McpStdioClient start/_rpc/_notify/_onLine and McpHttpClient _request/_openSseStream; tool dispatch surrounds managed model-facing result
mcp.evidence: Host result projection is distinct from restored execution arguments and server internal network; independent consumers/resources/errors are not proven universally protected

model.productionRelation: providerModelPostOnce physical POST; four business entries providerPostJsonOnce, probeProviderCompletion, openAiStreamOnce shared by runOpenAiTurn/runSubAgentCore, and singleSummaryCall; see four-entry table
model.evidence: Each business send reaches providerModelPostOnce, withPolicy preserves active scope or auxiliary fallback and binds OFF without creating a scope: await PrivacyGateway.beforeModelRequest, JSON.stringify, assertPolicyAvailable, then fetch without another await. Scope/alias reuse, OFF-to-ON and revision races, persistence failure and three protocols are exercised by privacy-model-send-boundary.e2e.js; recipient disclosure and media policy remain separate

provider-metadata.productionRelation: fetchOpenAiModels, probeNetwork, fetchProxyModels; URL/headers originate from configured providers
provider-metadata.evidence: Not chat body; existing credential scrubbing protects displays, not a universal recipient policy

toolbox-local.purpose: Probe, stop/unload or health check service
toolbox-local.evidence: Constructed 127.0.0.1 or locally supplied health host; service own sends are delegated and not covered

kimi-local.purpose: Talk to locally launched Kimi bridge
kimi-local.productionRelation: kimiHttp builds http://127.0.0.1:${port}${pathname}; server process classified CLI
kimi-local.evidence: Loopback hop does not protect Kimi upstream sends

media.purpose: Transcribe audio or maintain stream session
media.productionRelation: 13b-api-domain-routes audioStreamUpstream -> for non-DELETE assertMediaAllowed(await readConfig()) -> build headers -> final synchronous policy check -> fetch
media.evidence: Non-DELETE PCM chunks re-read configuration and perform a final synchronous policy check immediately before fetch. Read publication generations prevent a stale config read from replacing a newly committed policy. DELETE remains bodyless session cleanup. Actual loopback regression covers mode changes and cleanup; recipient contracts and local audio sanitization remain outside this fix.

web.recipient: requested website / search backend / configured proxy / DNS resolver
web.purpose: Search, fetch, download or issue HTTP tool requests
web.productionRelation: webFetch/httpGetGuarded/httpRequest/deepseekWebRequest/builtinSearch/webSearchViaBackend -> openHttpRequest -> direct/proxy/TLS; DNS has its own metadata disclosure
web.evidence: SSRF/permission and credential handling exist, but no common recipient-specific outbound privacy contract; authorized original tool arguments can leave host

acc-web.transport: Python urllib opener / pinned socket / DNS
acc-web.evidence: Pinned-IP SSRF checks are not privacy projection; standalone ACC process has no host model privacy scope

acc-browser.recipient: browser page, remote origin and page scripts
acc-browser.productionRelation: _ensure_browser connects to CDP or launches browser; browser_open goto; browser_evaluate delegates code
acc-browser.evidence: Browser can send independently through page scripts, navigation, extension state or injected JavaScript; no per-recipient isolation proved

bots.purpose: Discover platform identity, obtain token and deliver reply
bots.productionRelation: ExternalChannelDelivery.post and discovery request/probe; 13w bots/outbox call sendReply
bots.evidence: Identity/receipt/idempotency and bounded body handling do not constitute recipient-specific privacy projection

bot-gateway.purpose: Forward public webhook ingress to local workbench
bot-gateway.productionRelation: external-bot-gateway createGateway validates local upstream then http(s).request
bot-gateway.evidence: Ingress relay is not outbound bot reply or model request; listener exposure is a separate deployment concern

acc-server.purpose: Return desktop tool data to MCP consumer
acc-server.productionRelation: ACC server main invokes mcp.run(transport=stdio); library writes not visible as first-party socket calls
acc-server.evidence: Independent ACC consumer receives original desktop data; connecting to workbench does not establish a separate authenticated protected consumer scope

browser-dom.recipient: browser-selected origin or local Blob/data/same-origin resource
browser-dom.purpose: Render content, create a preview or activate a user navigation
browser-dom.productionRelation: public .src/.href/.srcdoc/.innerHTML and setAttribute src/href/srcdoc; includes renderMarkdownInto and file-browser iframe preview
browser-dom.evidence: index.html CSP restricts img-src to self/data/blob and connect-src to self; ordinary Markdown remote images are blocked by that CSP. Sanitizer alone allows http(s) href/src. External activated links and delegated desktop browser use need separate destination review; dynamic markup is not proven harmless by lexical inspection.

workbench-mcp-output.transport: workbench independent MCP server stdout JSON-RPC
workbench-mcp-output.recipient: independent consumer of workbench startMcp stdio server
workbench-mcp-output.purpose: Return workbench MCP tools/resources/errors and publish progress notifications
workbench-mcp-output.productionRelation: 13-http-router startMcp -> sendMcp or sendMcpNotification -> process.stdout.write; initialize/tools-list/tools-call/resources-list/resources-read/unknown-method/error and timer progress paths; distinct from managed MCP clients and independent ACC server
workbench-mcp-output.evidence: tools/resources list hide unsupported capabilities with privacy on; tools-call rechecks external-tool-result after execution, resources-read checks external-resource and masks config; catch rechecks external-error. sendMcp serializers and progress timer have no authenticated connection-bound privacy scope or common final disclosure contract. Off-mode may return original text/image results; initialization/progress/errors have separate behavior. Existing conditional refusal is not protected MCP delivery.

process-stdout.recipient: parent process or redirected stdout consumer
process-stdout.purpose: Emit process output outside its address space
process-stdout.productionRelation: First-party stdout.write site; workbench MCP serializers have a separate dedicated contract
process-stdout.evidence: Output may be logging/help/status or protocol data; no generic process-output privacy projection is proved by this source inventory.

audio-transcription.purpose: Transcribe audio or warm up ASR provider
audio-transcription.productionRelation: 05-claude-engine transcribeAudioViaProvider -> initial media check -> optional toolbox/config awaits -> original audio payload -> final synchronous policy check -> fetch
audio-transcription.evidence: The previous TOCTOU after toolbox setup/config hydration is fixed by a final synchronous policy check before fetch and generation-guarded config publication. privacy-audio-send-boundary.e2e.js tests basic/enhanced/strict switches, late real hydration and zero audio delivery to an actual loopback receiver. This does not implement local ASR, a recipient disclosure contract, or withdrawal of requests already submitted.

privacy-drive-probe.transport: fixed local Windows PowerShell child / stdin
privacy-drive-probe.purpose: Classify drive roots before probing a private file destination
privacy-drive-probe.productionRelation: PrivacyLocalDriveProbe.query validates and deduplicates root letters; start spawns a fixed script and pump writes only A-Z comma-separated roots
privacy-drive-probe.evidence: Reviewed 03b fixed script, strict reply grammar, lazy bounded queue, cancellation/deadlines and live ChildProcess cleanup; no model/body/secret file path is passed. This is local recipient classification, not process/network isolation or universal disclosure protection
